---
title: "Triage of recurrent wobble GWAS leads"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: kable
---

**Purpose.** Five SNPs recurred across earlier wobble-phenotype scans. Those scans used
*nested* sample sets (the same BAM fish appear in nearly all of them), so recurrence is not
replication. This report re-tests each lead in the 67 Bambomo (BAM) fish with two label sets
(the manual call and the label-free P0 classifier) and against the two continuous P0 traits
(`repro`, `|vP0|`). It also asks whether the signal rests on a handful of fish. APA fish are
reported as context for every lead and are the primary test population for lead 5 (TP vs
Wobble).

**What this is not.** It is not a new GWAS and not an independent replication. The BAM (and APA)
fish tested here were part of the discovery scans, so the manual-label p values below are
re-tests on discovery data and are expected to be small. The informative comparisons are
(i) whether the signal holds when the labels are replaced by the classifier's, which disagree
with the manual calls for a minority of fish, and (ii) whether it tracks the continuous traits. The
classifier labels largely agree with the manual ones, so (i) is a partial check, not an
independent one. Fisher and Spearman tests do not model kinship (unlike GEMMA's LMM), so
shared ancestry among a few fish can inflate them.

**Verdict rules (fixed before looking at the results).**

* Primary test = allelic Fisher exact (additive, like GEMMA's additive model); the 2x3
  genotypic Fisher is reported alongside and does not assume Hardy-Weinberg proportions.
* Bonferroni across the 5 leads (p x 5) is applied per test. A stricter all-tests correction
  (5 leads x 6 tests = p x 30) is reported as a robustness flag only.
* `survives clean labels`: classifier-label allelic test Bonferroni p < 0.05, same direction
  as the manual-label effect.
* `manual-label-only`: manual-label allelic Bonferroni p < 0.05, but the classifier-label
  test does not reach Bonferroni p < 0.05 (or the effect changes direction).
* `no support`: neither label set reaches Bonferroni p < 0.05.
* Primary population: BAM (BP vs Wobble) for leads 1-4; APA (TP vs Wobble) for lead 5, with
  BAM reported for it as well.

## Inputs and labels

```{r labels}
bam <- fread(bam_tsv) %>% as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(PN, pop = "BAM", manual, stat_call, n_sweeps, repro, abs_vP0,
            bin_manual = MANUAL_BIN, bin_cls = CLS_BIN, bin_strict = CLS_STRICT)
stopifnot(nrow(bam) == 67)

meta <- fread(meta_txt, sep = "\t") %>% as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(PN = `entity:participant_id`, meta_pheno = Phenotype, meta_pop = POP)
p0 <- fread(p0_csv) %>% as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(PN = sample_name, p0_manual = manual_Phenotype, stat_call, n_sweeps,
            repro, abs_vP0 = abs(vP0))

# APA = POP == "APA" in the master metadata (APA_223 is POP == BAM and is in the BAM table)
apa <- meta %>% filter(meta_pop == "APA") %>% left_join(p0, by = "PN") %>%
  mutate(pop = "APA", manual = meta_pheno,
         bin_manual = case_when(manual == "TP" ~ 0L, manual == "Wobble" ~ 1L),
         # classifier: TP-call = 0; Wobble- or BP-call (P0 reduced or absent) = 1; Ambiguous = NA
         bin_cls = case_when(stat_call == "TP" ~ 0L, stat_call %in% c("Wobble", "BP") ~ 1L),
         # strict: manual and classifier agree (TP/TP = 0, Wobble/Wobble = 1)
         bin_strict = case_when(manual == "TP" & stat_call == "TP" ~ 0L,
                                manual == "Wobble" & stat_call == "Wobble" ~ 1L)) %>%
  select(PN, pop, manual, stat_call, n_sweeps, repro, abs_vP0, bin_manual, bin_cls, bin_strict)
stopifnot(all(apa$manual == p0$p0_manual[match(apa$PN, p0$PN)]))

lab <- bind_rows(bam, apa)
count(lab, pop, manual, stat_call) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat_call, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

* BAM: `bin_manual` = `MANUAL_BIN` (BP = 0, Wobble = 1, TP = NA), `bin_cls` = `CLS_BIN`
  (classifier BP = 0, Wobble = 1; BAM_6494 anatomy-wobble = 1; Ambiguous and classifier-TP = NA),
  `bin_strict` = `CLS_STRICT` (sensitivity only).
* APA (no BP fish): `bin_manual` TP = 0 / Wobble = 1. `bin_cls` TP-call = 0 vs Wobble- or
  BP-call = 1 (both mean P0 is reduced or absent; Ambiguous = NA). Four manual APA wobbles are
  classifier TP-calls, which is what makes the APA classifier test informative.
* Continuous traits: Spearman of ALT dosage vs `repro` and `|vP0|`. BAM excludes the manual
  TP fish (BAM_6597); APA uses all fish (TP and Wobble span the trait range). Within-label
  Spearman tests (inside one manual class) are reported as a label-independent check.

## Genotype extraction and gene annotation

Sites monomorphic in the 97 BAM + APA fish are dropped at extraction. Whether each lead
position exists is checked against the full 305-sample VCF; if it were absent, the nearest SNP
within 1 kb would be used.

```{r extract}
extract_window <- function(chr, from, to, samples) {
  base <- sprintf("%s view -s %s -r %s:%d-%d %s 2>/dev/null | %s view -c 1:minor 2>/dev/null",
                  bcftools, paste(samples, collapse = ","), chr, max(1, from), to,
                  shQuote(vcf), bcftools)
  ids <- system(sprintf("%s | %s query -l", base, bcftools), intern = TRUE)
  dt <- fread(cmd = sprintf("%s | %s query -f '%%CHROM\\t%%POS\\t%%REF\\t%%ALT[\\t%%GT]\\n'",
                            base, bcftools),
              header = FALSE, sep = "\t", colClasses = "character")
  setnames(dt, c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT", ids))
  dt <- dt[!duplicated(dt$POS)]
  gt <- as.matrix(dt[, ..ids])
  dos <- (substr(gt, 1, 1) == "1") + (substr(gt, 3, 3) == "1")
  dos[!grepl("^[01][|/][01]$", gt)] <- NA
  rownames(gt) <- rownames(dos) <- dt$POS
  list(info = tibble(CHROM = dt$CHROM, POS = as.integer(dt$POS), REF = dt$REF, ALT = dt$ALT),
       gt = gt, dos = dos)
}

samples <- lab$PN
geno <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(leads)), function(i)
  extract_window(leads$chr[i], leads$pos[i] - WIN_EXT, leads$pos[i] + WIN_EXT, samples)),
  leads$lead)
stopifnot(all(sapply(geno, function(g) setequal(colnames(g$dos), samples))))
sapply(geno, function(g) c(n_polymorphic_snps_2Mb = nrow(g$dos), n_missing_gt = sum(is.na(g$dos))))

in_full_vcf <- function(chr, pos) {
  length(system(sprintf("%s query -r %s:%d-%d -f '%%POS\\n' %s 2>/dev/null",
                        bcftools, chr, pos, pos, shQuote(vcf)), intern = TRUE)) > 0
}
snps <- snps %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(
  exact_in_vcf = in_full_vcf(chr, pos),
  pos_used = { p <- geno[[lead]]$info$POS; d <- abs(p - pos)
               if (exact_in_vcf && pos %in% p) pos else if (min(d) <= 1000) p[which.min(d)] else NA_integer_ },
  snp_note = case_when(is.na(pos_used) ~ "no SNP within 1 kb",
                       pos_used == pos ~ "exact position present",
                       TRUE ~ paste0("exact position absent; nearest SNP ", pos_used - pos, " bp away")),
  snp = paste0(chr, ":", pos_used)) %>% ungroup()
kable(snps %>% select(lead, snp, role, exact_in_vcf, snp_note))

genes <- fread(cmd = sprintf("awk -F'\\t' '$3==\"gene\"||$3==\"pseudogene\"' %s", shQuote(gff)),
               header = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(chr = V1, start = V4, end = V5, strand = V7,
            name = str_match(V9, "Name=([^;]+)")[, 2],
            biotype = str_match(V9, "gene_biotype=([^;]+)")[, 2],
            description = vapply(coalesce(str_match(V9, "description=([^;]+)")[, 2], ""),
                                 URLdecode, character(1))) %>%
  filter(chr %in% leads$chr)
```

## Statistics

```{r stats-functions}
# Exact SNP-HWE test (Wigginton, Cutler & Abecasis 2005)
hwe_exact <- function(n_hom1, n_het, n_hom2) {
  homr <- min(n_hom1, n_hom2); homc <- max(n_hom1, n_hom2)
  rare <- 2 * homr + n_het; N <- n_het + homr + homc
  if (N == 0 || rare == 0) return(NA_real_)
  probs <- numeric(rare + 1)
  mid <- floor(rare * (2 * N - rare) / (2 * N))
  if ((mid %% 2) != (rare %% 2)) mid <- mid + 1
  probs[mid + 1] <- 1
  h <- mid; cr <- (rare - mid) / 2; cc <- N - mid - cr
  while (h >= 2) {
    probs[h - 1] <- probs[h + 1] * h * (h - 1) / (4 * (cr + 1) * (cc + 1))
    h <- h - 2; cr <- cr + 1; cc <- cc + 1
  }
  h <- mid; cr <- (rare - mid) / 2; cc <- N - mid - cr
  while (h <= rare - 2) {
    probs[h + 3] <- probs[h + 1] * 4 * cr * cc / ((h + 2) * (h + 1))
    h <- h + 2; cr <- cr - 1; cc <- cc - 1
  }
  probs <- probs / sum(probs)
  min(1, sum(probs[probs <= probs[n_het + 1] * (1 + 1e-7)]))
}
stopifnot(hwe_exact(25, 50, 25) > 0.99, hwe_exact(10, 0, 10) < 1e-4)

fisher_geno <- function(d, grp) {
  ok <- !is.na(d) & !is.na(grp)
  tb <- table(factor(grp[ok], levels = 0:1), factor(d[ok], levels = 0:2))
  tb <- tb[rowSums(tb) > 0, colSums(tb) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(tb) < 2 || ncol(tb) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  fisher.test(tb)$p.value
}
# allelic test; OR = odds of the ALT allele in group 1 (Wobble) vs group 0 (BP or TP)
fisher_allelic <- function(d, grp) {
  ok <- !is.na(d) & !is.na(grp)
  a1 <- sum(d[ok & grp == 1]); n1 <- 2 * sum(ok & grp == 1)
  a0 <- sum(d[ok & grp == 0]); n0 <- 2 * sum(ok & grp == 0)
  tb <- matrix(c(a1, n1 - a1, a0, n0 - a0), 2, byrow = TRUE)
  if (any(rowSums(tb) == 0) || any(colSums(tb) == 0)) return(c(p = NA, or = NA))
  ft <- fisher.test(tb)
  c(p = ft$p.value, or = unname(ft$estimate))
}
spear <- function(d, y) {
  ok <- !is.na(d) & !is.na(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 5 || var(d[ok]) == 0) return(c(rho = NA, p = NA, n = sum(ok)))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  c(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = sum(ok))
}
cnt <- function(d) paste(table(factor(d, levels = 0:2)), collapse = "/")  # homREF/het/homALT
cnt_by <- function(d, g, lv) paste(sapply(lv, function(l) paste(l, cnt(d[g %in% l]))), collapse = " | ")
```

```{r run-tests}
per_snp <- list(); per_fish <- list(); hwe_rows <- list(); within_rows <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(snps))) {
  s <- snps[i, ]; g <- geno[[s$lead]]; key <- as.character(s$pos_used)
  inf <- g$info %>% filter(POS == s$pos_used)
  pf <- lab %>% mutate(lead = s$lead, snp = s$snp, role = s$role, REF = inf$REF, ALT = inf$ALT,
                       GT = g$gt[key, PN], dosage = g$dos[key, PN])
  per_fish[[i]] <- pf
  res <- list(lead = s$lead, role = s$role, snp = s$snp, snp_note = s$snp_note,
              REF = inf$REF, ALT = inf$ALT)
  for (P in c("BAM", "APA")) {
    x <- pf %>% filter(pop == P)
    af <- mean(x$dosage) / 2
    res[[paste0("af_", P)]] <- af
    res[[paste0("minor_", P)]] <- if (af <= 0.5) inf$ALT else inf$REF
    lv_m <- if (P == "BAM") c("BP", "Wobble", "TP") else c("TP", "Wobble")
    lv_c <- if (P == "BAM") c("BP", "Wobble", "Ambiguous", "TP") else c("TP", "Wobble", "BP", "Ambiguous")
    res[[paste0("geno_manual_", P)]] <- cnt_by(x$dosage, x$manual, lv_m)
    res[[paste0("geno_cls_", P)]]    <- cnt_by(x$dosage, x$stat_call, lv_c)
    for (L in c("manual", "cls", "strict")) {
      gg <- x[[paste0("bin_", L)]]
      fa <- fisher_allelic(x$dosage, gg)
      if (L != "strict") res[[paste0("fisher_geno_", L, "_", P)]] <- fisher_geno(x$dosage, gg)
      res[[paste0("fisher_allelic_", L, "_", P)]] <- fa[["p"]]
      res[[paste0("OR_alt_", L, "_", P)]]         <- fa[["or"]]
      res[[paste0("af_g0_", L, "_", P)]] <- mean(x$dosage[gg %in% 0]) / 2
      res[[paste0("af_g1_", L, "_", P)]] <- mean(x$dosage[gg %in% 1]) / 2
    }
    xs <- if (P == "BAM") x %>% filter(manual != "TP") else x
    for (tr in c("repro", "abs_vP0")) {
      sp <- spear(xs$dosage, xs[[tr]])
      res[[paste0("rho_", tr, "_", P)]] <- sp[["rho"]]
      res[[paste0("p_", tr, "_", P)]]   <- sp[["p"]]
      res[[paste0("n_", tr, "_", P)]]   <- sp[["n"]]
      for (l in if (P == "BAM") c("BP", "Wobble") else c("TP", "Wobble")) {
        sw <- spear(x$dosage[x$manual == l], x[[tr]][x$manual == l])
        within_rows[[length(within_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(lead = s$lead, role = s$role, snp = s$snp,
          pop = P, within = l, trait = tr, rho = sw[["rho"]], p = sw[["p"]], n = sw[["n"]],
          n_minor_carriers = sum(if (af <= 0.5) x$dosage[x$manual == l] > 0 else x$dosage[x$manual == l] < 2))
      }
    }
    grp_list <- list(all = rep(TRUE, nrow(x)))
    for (l in lv_m) grp_list[[paste0("manual_", l)]] <- x$manual == l
    if (P == "BAM") for (l in c("BP", "Wobble")) grp_list[[paste0("cls_", l)]] <- x$bin_cls %in% as.integer(l == "Wobble")
    for (gn in names(grp_list)) {
      dd <- x$dosage[grp_list[[gn]]]
      if (length(dd) < 5) next
      n0 <- sum(dd == 0); n1 <- sum(dd == 1); n2 <- sum(dd == 2); n <- length(dd)
      q <- (n1 + 2 * n2) / (2 * n)
      hwe_rows[[length(hwe_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        lead = s$lead, snp = s$snp, pop = P, group = gn, n = n,
        counts = paste(n0, n1, n2, sep = "/"), het_obs = n1 / n, het_exp = 2 * q * (1 - q),
        hwe_p = hwe_exact(n0, n1, n2))
    }
  }
  # BAM fish whose manual and classifier labels disagree in the BP/Wobble direction
  xb <- pf %>% filter(pop == "BAM")
  re <- xb %>% filter(manual == "Wobble", stat_call == "BP")
  res$reassigned_WobToBP <- paste0(paste(re$PN, re$dosage, sep = "=", collapse = ","),
                                  sprintf(" (ALT freq %.2f)", mean(re$dosage) / 2))
  res$af_reassigned_WobToBP <- mean(re$dosage) / 2
  res$dosage_BAM_6494 <- xb$dosage[xb$PN == "BAM_6494"]
  # sensitivity (BAM, manual allelic): drop minor homozygotes; worst leave-one-out
  minor_dos <- if (res$af_BAM <= 0.5) 2 else 0
  mh <- xb %>% filter(dosage == minor_dos)
  res$n_minor_hom_BAM <- nrow(mh)
  res$minor_hom_BAM <- if (nrow(mh)) paste(sprintf("%s(%s/%s; repro %s; |vP0| %s)", mh$PN, mh$manual,
      mh$stat_call, ifelse(is.na(mh$repro), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", mh$repro)),
      sprintf("%.1e", mh$abs_vP0)), collapse = "; ") else ""
  keep <- xb$dosage != minor_dos
  res$p_allelic_manual_BAM_drop_minor_hom <- fisher_allelic(xb$dosage[keep], xb$bin_manual[keep])[["p"]]
  res$p_allelic_cls_BAM_drop_minor_hom    <- fisher_allelic(xb$dosage[keep], xb$bin_cls[keep])[["p"]]
  idx <- which(!is.na(xb$bin_manual))
  res$p_allelic_manual_BAM_worst_LOO <- max(sapply(idx, function(j)
    fisher_allelic(xb$dosage[-j], xb$bin_manual[-j])[["p"]]))
  xa <- pf %>% filter(pop == "APA")
  minor_a <- if (res$af_APA <= 0.5) 2 else 0
  mha <- xa %>% filter(dosage == minor_a)
  res$n_minor_hom_APA <- nrow(mha)
  res$minor_hom_APA <- if (nrow(mha)) paste(sprintf("%s(%s/%s; |vP0| %s)", mha$PN, mha$manual,
      mha$stat_call, sprintf("%.1e", mha$abs_vP0)), collapse = "; ") else ""
  keepa <- xa$dosage != minor_a
  res$p_allelic_manual_APA_drop_minor_hom <- fisher_allelic(xa$dosage[keepa], xa$bin_manual[keepa])[["p"]]
  res$p_allelic_cls_APA_drop_minor_hom    <- fisher_allelic(xa$dosage[keepa], xa$bin_cls[keepa])[["p"]]
  idxa <- which(!is.na(xa$bin_manual))
  res$p_allelic_manual_APA_worst_LOO <- suppressWarnings(max(sapply(idxa, function(j)
    fisher_allelic(xa$dosage[-j], xa$bin_manual[-j])[["p"]]), na.rm = TRUE))
  per_snp[[i]] <- as_tibble(res)
}
per_snp  <- bind_rows(per_snp)
per_fish <- bind_rows(per_fish)
hwe_tab  <- bind_rows(hwe_rows)
within_tab <- bind_rows(within_rows)

pcols <- grep("^(fisher_(allelic|geno)_(manual|cls)_|p_repro_|p_abs_vP0_)", names(per_snp), value = TRUE)
per_snp <- per_snp %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pcols), ~ pmin(1, .x * N_LEADS), .names = "{.col}_bonf"),
         across(all_of(pcols), ~ pmin(1, .x * N_LEADS * N_TESTS), .names = "{.col}_bonf30"))
```

## Results per SNP

ALT-allele dosage throughout. Counts are `homREF/het/homALT`. OR = odds of ALT in group 1
(Wobble) vs group 0 (BAM: BP; APA: TP). "Bonf" = x5 leads.

```{r show-per-snp}
per_snp %>% transmute(lead, role, snp, `REF>ALT` = paste0(REF, ">", ALT),
  af_BAM = round(af_BAM, 3), geno_manual_BAM, geno_cls_BAM,
  `allelic p manual (Bonf)` = paste0(fmt(fisher_allelic_manual_BAM), " (", fmt(fisher_allelic_manual_BAM_bonf), ")"),
  `geno p manual` = fmt(fisher_geno_manual_BAM),
  `OR manual` = round(OR_alt_manual_BAM, 2),
  `allelic p cls (Bonf)` = paste0(fmt(fisher_allelic_cls_BAM), " (", fmt(fisher_allelic_cls_BAM_bonf), ")"),
  `geno p cls` = fmt(fisher_geno_cls_BAM),
  `OR cls` = round(OR_alt_cls_BAM, 2),
  `allelic p strict` = fmt(fisher_allelic_strict_BAM)) %>% kable()
```

**Continuous traits (BAM, manual TP excluded):**

**Fish where manual and classifier labels disagree** (BAM; ALT dosage at each primary SNP).
The four manual-Wobble / classifier-BP fish (APA_223, BAM_175, BAM_6499, BAM_6834) and
BAM_6494 (manual BP, classifier-wobble by anatomy) are the fish that move between groups when
labels change. If they carry the genotype of their *manual* group, the classifier test loses
power for that lead. That pattern does not by itself say which label is right. Descriptive only (n = 5).

```{r show-discordant}

  (manual == "Wobble" & stat_call != "Wobble") | (manual == "BP" & stat_call != "BP")) %>% pull(PN)

  select(PN, manual, stat_call, bin_cls, repro, abs_vP0, lead, dosage) %>%
  mutate(repro = round(repro, 2), abs_vP0 = signif(abs_vP0, 2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lead, values_from = dosage) %>% arrange(manual, stat_call) %>% kable()
per_snp %>% filter(role == "primary") %>% transmute(lead, snp,
  `ALT freq manual BP` = round(af_g0_manual_BAM, 2), `ALT freq manual Wobble` = round(af_g1_manual_BAM, 2),
  `ALT freq 4 Wob->clsBP fish` = round(af_reassigned_WobToBP, 2),
  `resemble` = ifelse(abs(af_reassigned_WobToBP - af_g1_manual_BAM) < abs(af_reassigned_WobToBP - af_g0_manual_BAM),
                      "manual Wobble", "BP"),
  `BAM_6494 dosage` = dosage_BAM_6494) %>% kable()
```

## Local LD blocks and genes

r^2 is the squared Pearson correlation of ALT dosages between the lead and every SNP within
+/-250 kb with within-population MAF >= `r MAF_LD` (the lead is always kept). The block is the
span from the leftmost to the rightmost SNP with r^2 >= `r R2_BLK`; it can include gaps. LD is
computed in BAM for all leads (as specified) and also in APA for L5, whose lead is rare in BAM.
The block used for genes is the one from the lead's primary population. A +/-1 Mb extent is
reported only to show whether a block runs past the +/-250 kb window.

```{r ld}
ld_one <- function(L, P, half) {
  g <- geno[[L$lead]]; ids <- lab$PN[lab$pop == P]
  D <- g$dos[, ids, drop = FALSE]
  inwin <- abs(g$info$POS - L$pos) <= half
  af <- rowMeans(D) / 2; maf <- pmin(af, 1 - af)
  is_lead <- g$info$POS == L$pos
  keep <- inwin & (maf >= MAF_LD | is_lead)
  lead_d <- D[as.character(L$pos), ]
  if (var(lead_d) == 0) return(NULL)
  r2 <- suppressWarnings(as.vector(cor(t(D[keep, , drop = FALSE]), lead_d)^2))
  g$info[keep, ] %>% mutate(lead = L$lead, ld_pop = P, maf = maf[keep], r2 = r2, dist = POS - L$pos)
}
block_of <- function(ld, L, half) {
  blk <- ld %>% filter(r2 >= R2_BLK)
  tibble(block_start = min(blk$POS), block_end = max(blk$POS),
         block_span_kb = round((max(blk$POS) - min(blk$POS)) / 1000, 1), n_block_snps = nrow(blk),
         block_at_window_edge = any(abs(blk$dist) >= half - EDGE),
         max_r2_other = max(ld$r2[ld$POS != L$pos], na.rm = TRUE))
}
ld_rows <- list(); blocks <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(leads))) {
  L <- leads[i, ]
  for (P in unique(c("BAM", L$primary_pop))) {
    ld  <- ld_one(L, P, WIN)
    ldx <- ld_one(L, P, WIN_EXT)
    if (is.null(ld)) next
    ld_rows[[length(ld_rows) + 1]] <- ld
    b  <- block_of(ld, L, WIN)
    bx <- block_of(ldx, L, WIN_EXT)
    blocks[[length(blocks) + 1]] <- bind_cols(tibble(lead = L$lead, ld_pop = P,
      lead_maf = round(ld$maf[ld$POS == L$pos], 3), n_window_snps = nrow(ld)), b,
      ext_1Mb_start = bx$block_start, ext_1Mb_end = bx$block_end,
      ext_1Mb_span_kb = bx$block_span_kb, ext_1Mb_n = bx$n_block_snps)
  }
}
ld_all <- bind_rows(ld_rows); blocks <- bind_rows(blocks)
blocks %>% mutate(max_r2_other = round(max_r2_other, 2)) %>% kable()

# genes: from the primary-population block
gene_rows <- list(); block_genes <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(leads))) {
  L <- leads[i, ]; b <- blocks %>% filter(lead == L$lead, ld_pop == L$primary_pop)
  gi <- genes %>% filter(chr == L$chr, end >= b$block_start, start <= b$block_end)
  gc <- genes %>% filter(chr == L$chr) %>%
    mutate(dist_to_lead = pmax(0, start - L$pos, L$pos - end)) %>% arrange(dist_to_lead)
  near <- gc %>% slice(1); near_pc <- gc %>% filter(biotype == "protein_coding") %>% slice(1)
  gene_rows[[i]] <- tibble(lead = L$lead,
    genes = if (nrow(gi)) paste(gi$name, collapse = ";") else "none",
    lead_in_gene = if (near$dist_to_lead == 0) near$name else "intergenic",
    nearest_gene = sprintf("%s (%s, %s bp)", near$name, near$biotype, near$dist_to_lead),
    nearest_protein_coding = sprintf("%s (%s bp; %s)", near_pc$name, near_pc$dist_to_lead, near_pc$description))
  block_genes[[i]] <- gi %>% mutate(lead = L$lead, ld_pop = L$primary_pop, .before = 1)
}
gene_tab <- bind_rows(gene_rows); block_genes <- bind_rows(block_genes)
kable(gene_tab)
kable(block_genes %>% select(lead, name, start, end, biotype, description))
```

Pairwise r^2 (BAM) between the recurrent positions within a lead:

```{r pair-r2}
bam_ids <- lab$PN[lab$pop == "BAM"]
snps %>% filter(role == "secondary") %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(
  r2_with_primary_BAM = round(cor(geno[[lead]]$dos[as.character(pos_used), bam_ids],
    geno[[lead]]$dos[as.character(leads$pos[leads$lead == lead]), bam_ids])^2, 3)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(lead, snp, r2_with_primary_BAM) %>% kable()
```

Left: ALT dosage at the primary SNP against |vP0| (log scale), BAM and APA; colour = manual
label, shape = classifier call. Right: r^2 with the lead across +/-250 kb in the lead's
primary population, genes as grey bars, dashed line at r^2 = 0.5.

```{r figs, fig.height = 4.2, results = "asis"}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(leads))) {
  L <- leads[i, ]
  pf <- per_fish %>% filter(lead == L$lead, role == "primary")
  p1 <- ggplot(pf, aes(x = factor(dosage, levels = 0:2), y = abs_vP0)) +

    scale_y_log10() + facet_wrap(~ pop) +

  ld <- ld_all %>% filter(lead == L$lead, ld_pop == L$primary_pop)
  gg <- genes %>% filter(chr == L$chr, end >= L$pos - WIN, start <= L$pos + WIN) %>%

    theme_bw(10)
```

## Verdicts

```{r verdict}
prim <- per_snp %>% filter(role == "primary") %>%
  left_join(leads %>% select(lead, primary_pop), by = "lead")
getp <- function(r, stem, P, suffix = "") r[[paste0(stem, "_", P, suffix)]]
verdict_one <- function(r, P) {
  pm <- getp(r, "fisher_allelic_manual", P, "_bonf"); pc <- getp(r, "fisher_allelic_cls", P, "_bonf")
  om <- getp(r, "OR_alt_manual", P); oc <- getp(r, "OR_alt_cls", P)
  same_dir <- !is.na(om) && !is.na(oc) && sign(log(om)) == sign(log(oc))
  if (!is.na(pc) && pc < 0.05 && same_dir) "survives clean labels"
  else if (!is.na(pm) && pm < 0.05) "manual-label-only"
  else "no support"
}
prim$verdict <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(prim)), function(k) verdict_one(prim[k, ], prim$primary_pop[k]), character(1))
prim$verdict_BAM <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(prim)), function(k) verdict_one(prim[k, ], "BAM"), character(1))
prim$robust_all_tests <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(prim)), function(k) {
  r <- prim[k, ]; P <- r$primary_pop
  isTRUE(getp(r, "fisher_allelic_cls", P, "_bonf30") < 0.05)
}, logical(1))

prim <- prim %>% left_join(blocks %>% filter(ld_pop == "BAM") %>%
                             select(lead, n_block_snps_BAM = n_block_snps, max_r2_other_BAM = max_r2_other), by = "lead")
prim$reasoning <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(prim)), function(k) {
  r <- prim[k, ]; P <- r$primary_pop
  base <- sprintf("%s manual p=%s -> classifier p=%s (Bonf x5 %s, x30 %s); repro rho=%.2f p=%s, |vP0| rho=%.2f p=%s",
    P, fmt(getp(r, "fisher_allelic_manual", P)), fmt(getp(r, "fisher_allelic_cls", P)),
    fmt(getp(r, "fisher_allelic_cls", P, "_bonf")), fmt(getp(r, "fisher_allelic_cls", P, "_bonf30")),
    getp(r, "rho_repro", P), fmt(getp(r, "p_repro", P)),
    getp(r, "rho_abs_vP0", P), fmt(getp(r, "p_abs_vP0", P)))
  extra <- c()
  if (P == "BAM") {
    extra <- c(extra, sprintf("4 manual-Wob/cls-BP fish ALT freq %.2f (BP %.2f, Wob %.2f)",
                              r$af_reassigned_WobToBP, r$af_g0_manual_BAM, r$af_g1_manual_BAM))
    if (r$n_minor_hom_BAM > 0) extra <- c(extra, sprintf("%d BAM minor homs; cls p without them %s",
                              r$n_minor_hom_BAM, fmt(r$p_allelic_cls_BAM_drop_minor_hom)))
    if (r$af_APA == 0 || r$af_APA == 1) extra <- c(extra, "monomorphic in APA")
    if (r$n_block_snps_BAM == 1) extra <- c(extra, sprintf("no LD partner r2>=0.5 within 250 kb (max %.2f)", r$max_r2_other_BAM))
  } else {
    pa <- per_fish %>% filter(lead == r$lead, role == "primary", pop == P)
    mw_tp <- pa %>% filter(manual == "Wobble", stat_call == "TP")
    wt <- within_tab %>% filter(lead == r$lead, role == "primary", pop == P, within == "TP", trait == "abs_vP0")
    extra <- c(extra,
      sprintf("%d manual-Wob/cls-TP fish dosages %s, |vP0| max %.1e vs manual-TP min %.1e",
              nrow(mw_tp), paste(mw_tp$dosage, collapse = ","), max(mw_tp$abs_vP0, na.rm = TRUE),
              min(pa$abs_vP0[pa$manual == "TP"], na.rm = TRUE)),
      sprintf("within manual TP |vP0| rho=%.2f p=%s (%d minor carriers)", wt$rho, fmt(wt$p), wt$n_minor_carriers),
      sprintf("BAM: ALT freq %.3f, manual p=%s, cls p=%s (%s)", r$af_BAM,
              fmt(r$fisher_allelic_manual_BAM), fmt(r$fisher_allelic_cls_BAM), r$verdict_BAM))
  }
  paste(c(base, extra), collapse = "; ")
}, character(1))
prim %>% select(lead, snp, verdict, robust_all_tests, reasoning) %>% kable()
```

## Reading the results

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
v  <- function(l, col) prim[[col]][prim$lead == l]
bk <- function(l, col, P = NULL) { P <- P %||% leads$primary_pop[leads$lead == l]
  blocks[[col]][blocks$lead == l & blocks$ld_pop == P] }
wi <- function(l, P, w, tr) within_tab %>% filter(lead == l, role == "primary", pop == P, within == w, trait == tr)
```

These notes are modest by design: n is small, every fish here was in the discovery scans,
and the tests ignore kinship.

* **L3 (chr13:31603593) is the strongest BAM lead.** Its classifier-label test
  (p = `r fmt(v("L3","fisher_allelic_cls_BAM"))`) and its `repro` association
  (rho = `r round(v("L3","rho_repro_BAM"),2)`, p = `r fmt(v("L3","p_repro_BAM"))`) both pass even
  the x30 correction. Every carrier is heterozygous (`r v("L3","geno_manual_BAM")`), so no
  small set of homozygotes drives it. The allele is also present in APA
  (freq `r round(v("L3","af_APA"),2)`) with no TP/Wobble association there. Its BAM block spans
  `r bk("L3","block_span_kb")` kb (`r bk("L3","n_block_snps")` SNPs, `r sum(block_genes$lead=="L3")` genes).
  The second recurrent position (chr13:31616325) is in complete LD with it in BAM.
* **L5 (chr7:13388648) is an APA lead, not a BAM lead.** In APA it tracks the manual label
  (p = `r fmt(v("L5","fisher_allelic_manual_APA"))`), the classifier label
  (p = `r fmt(v("L5","fisher_allelic_cls_APA"))`) and |vP0| (rho = `r round(v("L5","rho_abs_vP0_APA"),2)`,
  p = `r fmt(v("L5","p_abs_vP0_APA"))`). The four manual wobbles that the classifier calls TP all carry
  the ALT allele and have lower |vP0| than any manual TP. Inside the manual TP class alone, the
  `r wi("L5","APA","TP","abs_vP0")$n_minor_carriers` carriers are the TPs with the lowest |vP0|
  (rho = `r round(wi("L5","APA","TP","abs_vP0")$rho,2)`, p = `r fmt(wi("L5","APA","TP","abs_vP0")$p)`).
  That is a label-independent signal. There is no dose-response among wobbles
  (homozygotes vs hets: rho = `r round(wi("L5","APA","Wobble","abs_vP0")$rho,2)`). In BAM the allele is
  rare (freq `r round(v("L5","af_BAM"),3)`) and unassociated.
* **L1 (chr9) and L4 (chr3) pass the pre-set rule only at x5, not x30.**
  L1 has no other SNP within +/-250 kb at r^2 >= 0.5 in BAM (max `r round(bk("L1","max_r2_other"),2)`),
  although SNP density is high and the other leads have `r paste(range(blocks$n_block_snps[blocks$ld_pop == "BAM" & blocks$lead != "L1"]), collapse = "-")` partners in BAM. Its ALT allele is absent
  from APA. Within manual BP fish its trait association runs opposite to the between-label effect
  (repro rho = `r round(wi("L1","BAM","BP","repro")$rho,2)`). Treat it as a possible genotyping or mapping
  artifact until read-level support is checked.
  L4's classifier signal depends on the `r v("L4","n_minor_hom_BAM")` BP minor-allele homozygotes
  (classifier p = `r fmt(v("L4","p_allelic_cls_BAM_drop_minor_hom"))` without them). Its block is large
  (`r bk("L4","ext_1Mb_span_kb")` kb within +/-1 Mb) and sits in a gene desert (lncRNAs only; nearest
  protein-coding gene `r gene_tab$nearest_protein_coding[gene_tab$lead=="L4"]`).
* **L2 (chr4, colec12) is manual-label-only.** The wobble-associated allele is the one fixed in APA.
* At L1, L2 and L4 the four manual-Wobble / classifier-BP fish carry the manual-wobble
  genotype (table above), which is where the classifier tests lose power. With n = 4 this
  cannot say which label is right.
* `r if (all(hwe_tab$hwe_p >= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) "None of the tested SNPs deviates from Hardy-Weinberg (exact p < 0.05) within any group." else paste("HWE deviations (p < 0.05):", nrow(hw), "group x SNP rows; see table above.")`

```{r write}
bbam  <- blocks %>% filter(ld_pop == "BAM") %>%
  transmute(lead, block_BAM = sprintf("%s-%s (%s kb, %s SNPs)", block_start, block_end, block_span_kb, n_block_snps))
wwide <- within_tab %>% filter(role == "primary") %>%
  transmute(lead, key = paste0("within_", pop, "_", within, "_", trait),
            val = ifelse(is.na(rho), "NA", sprintf("rho %.2f p %s", rho, fmt(p)))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = val)

  left_join(gene_tab, by = "lead") %>%

    geno_manual_BAM, geno_cls_BAM, geno_manual_APA, geno_cls_APA,
    fisher_allelic_manual_p = signif(fisher_allelic_manual_BAM, 3),

    OR_alt_manual = round(OR_alt_manual_BAM, 3),
    fisher_allelic_cls_p = signif(fisher_allelic_cls_BAM, 3),
    fisher_allelic_cls_p_bonf = signif(fisher_allelic_cls_BAM_bonf, 3),
    fisher_allelic_cls_p_bonf30 = signif(fisher_allelic_cls_BAM_bonf30, 3),
    fisher_geno_cls_p = signif(fisher_geno_cls_BAM, 3),
    fisher_geno_cls_p_bonf = signif(fisher_geno_cls_BAM_bonf, 3),
    OR_alt_cls = round(OR_alt_cls_BAM, 3),
    fisher_allelic_strict_p = signif(fisher_allelic_strict_BAM, 3),
    spearman_rho_repro = round(rho_repro_BAM, 3), spearman_p_repro = signif(p_repro_BAM, 3),
    spearman_p_repro_bonf = signif(p_repro_BAM_bonf, 3),
    spearman_rho_abs_vP0 = round(rho_abs_vP0_BAM, 3), spearman_p_abs_vP0 = signif(p_abs_vP0_BAM, 3),
    spearman_p_abs_vP0_bonf = signif(p_abs_vP0_BAM_bonf, 3),
    APA_fisher_allelic_manual_p = signif(fisher_allelic_manual_APA, 3),
    APA_fisher_allelic_manual_p_bonf = signif(fisher_allelic_manual_APA_bonf, 3),
    APA_fisher_geno_manual_p = signif(fisher_geno_manual_APA, 3),
    APA_OR_alt_manual = round(OR_alt_manual_APA, 3),
    APA_fisher_allelic_cls_p = signif(fisher_allelic_cls_APA, 3),
    APA_fisher_allelic_cls_p_bonf = signif(fisher_allelic_cls_APA_bonf, 3),
    APA_fisher_allelic_cls_p_bonf30 = signif(fisher_allelic_cls_APA_bonf30, 3),
    APA_fisher_geno_cls_p = signif(fisher_geno_cls_APA, 3),
    APA_OR_alt_cls = round(OR_alt_cls_APA, 3),
    APA_fisher_allelic_strict_p = signif(fisher_allelic_strict_APA, 3),
    APA_spearman_rho_abs_vP0 = round(rho_abs_vP0_APA, 3), APA_spearman_p_abs_vP0 = signif(p_abs_vP0_APA, 3),
    APA_spearman_p_abs_vP0_bonf = signif(p_abs_vP0_APA_bonf, 3),
    APA_spearman_rho_repro = round(rho_repro_APA, 3), APA_spearman_p_repro = signif(p_repro_APA, 3),
    reassigned_WobToBP, dosage_BAM_6494,
    n_minor_hom_BAM, minor_hom_BAM,
    p_allelic_manual_drop_minor_hom = signif(p_allelic_manual_BAM_drop_minor_hom, 3),
    p_allelic_cls_drop_minor_hom = signif(p_allelic_cls_BAM_drop_minor_hom, 3),
    p_allelic_manual_worst_LOO = signif(p_allelic_manual_BAM_worst_LOO, 3),
    n_minor_hom_APA, minor_hom_APA,
    ld_pop = ld_pop, block_start, block_end, block_span_kb, n_block_snps, block_at_window_edge,
    max_r2_other = round(max_r2_other, 3), ext_1Mb_start, ext_1Mb_end, ext_1Mb_span_kb, ext_1Mb_n,
    block_BAM, genes, lead_in_gene, nearest_gene, nearest_protein_coding,
    verdict, robust_all_tests, reasoning, source_runs) %>%
  left_join(wwide, by = "lead") %>%
  relocate(starts_with("within_"), .after = p_allelic_manual_worst_LOO)
fwrite(summary_tab, file.path(outdir, "leads_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(per_snp %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4))),
       file.path(outdir, "per_snp_tests.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(within_tab %>% mutate(across(c(rho, p), ~ signif(.x, 4))),
       file.path(outdir, "within_label_spearman.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(hwe_tab %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4))),
       file.path(outdir, "hwe_by_group.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(block_genes, file.path(outdir, "block_genes.tsv"), sep = "\t")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(leads))) {
  L <- leads[i, ]; tag <- paste0(L$lead, "_", L$chr, "_", L$pos)
  pf <- per_fish %>% filter(lead == L$lead) %>%
    select(lead, role, snp, REF, ALT, PN, pop, manual, stat_call, bin_manual, bin_cls,
           n_sweeps, repro, abs_vP0, GT, dosage)
  fwrite(pf, file.path(outdir, paste0(tag, ".genotypes.tsv")), sep = "\t")
  cnts <- pf %>% pivot_longer(c(manual, stat_call), names_to = "label_set", values_to = "label") %>%
    group_by(snp, role, pop, label_set, label) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), homREF = sum(dosage == 0), het = sum(dosage == 1), homALT = sum(dosage == 2),
              alt_freq = round(mean(dosage) / 2, 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label_set = recode(label_set, stat_call = "classifier"))
  fwrite(cnts, file.path(outdir, paste0(tag, ".genotype_counts.tsv")), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(ld_all %>% filter(lead == L$lead) %>% mutate(r2 = round(r2, 4), maf = round(maf, 4)),
         file.path(outdir, paste0(tag, ".ld_r2.tsv")), sep = "\t")
}
list.files(outdir)
```
